## The Approximation of Blur Restoration Filters by Finite Impulse Responses Image

## R W. SCHUTTEN AND G. F VERMEIJ

Abstract-Image blur can often be modeled by linear spatially invariant, symmetric point spread function. For this class of functions, several restoration filters are known in the literature \_

The  approximation of their frequency transfer functions (ftf's) by the ftf's of small finite impulse response (FIR) filters has been studied Accurate   approximations will be possible by 9 X 9 FIR's with 8-bit elements if the approximation is done in weighted MMSE sense, and if the truncation of the element values will be carried out such that the A heuristic   truncation algorithm MINIM will be described An example of restoration by a 9 X 9 FIR will be shown.

## 1. INTRODUCTION

In the literature on image   processing [1]-[3] a number of restoration filters are known, which can be applied in the case of spatially invariant image blurring.
